verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements SaaS with a dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows no assistant inside the product. The MCP server connects external AI assistants to Autumn, which is a different capability (serving tools to outside agents), and AI token-usage tracking is a pricing feature, not task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
